lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Houston businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Houston is an industrial and medical city spread over a huge area, with one of the most diverse populations in the country. We plan marketing for the buyer you actually have, whether that is a procurement engineer in the Energy Corridor or a family in Katy looking for a dentist.

sections.heading: An economy built on energy, medicine and trade
paragraphs: Houston is known worldwide as a centre of the oil and gas industry, and that reputation is earned. Operators, service companies, engineering firms and equipment makers are concentrated here, along with a vast petrochemical complex along the Ship Channel and one of the busiest ports in the United States. The Texas Medical Center is among the largest concentrations of hospitals and research institutions anywhere, and NASA's Johnson Space Center has supported an aerospace community around Clear Lake for decades.

Much of the city's commerce is therefore business to business. A valve distributor, an inspection company, a safety trainer or an industrial software firm sells to technical buyers who research carefully and take time to decide. They want specifications, certifications and proof of capability on the page. Marketing for these firms means detailed service content, search visibility for precise terms, LinkedIn activity that reaches the right job titles and a website that a busy engineer can use quickly.

sections.heading: A city measured in drive time
paragraphs: Houston spreads outward in rings: neighbourhoods inside Loop 610 such as the Heights, Montrose, Midtown and River Oaks, then the Galleria and the Beltway, then large suburbs including Katy, Sugar Land, Cypress, Pearland and The Woodlands. With little formal zoning, shops, offices and homes mix freely, and commutes are long. Consumers choose by how long it takes to get there.
For local businesses this makes location targeting the centre of the plan. A campaign that covers the whole metro pays for clicks from people an hour away.
bullets: Pages and Google Business Profiles for each area you serve, named the way residents name it.
Ad targeting set by realistic travel distance from each location.
Separate budgets for suburbs that perform differently, so Katy does not subsidise Pearland.
Review collection built into your routine, because map rankings depend on it.
Tracking that ties calls and forms to revenue.

sections.heading: Business districts beyond downtown
paragraphs: Houston has several business centres instead of one. Downtown and the Galleria area hold corporate offices and retail, the Energy Corridor along Interstate 10 houses oil and gas companies, and the Texas Medical Center is a district in its own right. Bellaire Boulevard in the southwest is a major commercial strip known for its Asian restaurants and shops, and Hillcroft for South Asian food and retail.

This affects practical choices: which district names appear on your pages, which hours your ads run, and whether you are selling to office workers at lunchtime or to households in the evening. We map where your customers come from before setting targeting.

sections.heading: Weather and the calendar
paragraphs: Long, humid summers keep air-conditioning companies busy, and the Gulf hurricane season can turn roofing, restoration and tree services into urgent needs overnight. The Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo fills weeks of the late-winter calendar, and large energy conferences bring international visitors. We build these into content and budget plans ahead of time.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Houston?
faqs.a: No. We work with Houston businesses remotely. Calls, shared documents and regular reporting keep the work visible to you.

faqs.q: Can digital marketing work for an oil and gas service company?
faqs.a: Yes. Buyers in the sector research suppliers online before making contact. A site with clear technical content, plus search and LinkedIn campaigns aimed at specific roles, produces enquiries from the right people. Sales cycles are long, so results are measured over months.

faqs.q: How should a Houston business market during hurricane season?
faqs.a: Plan ahead of the Gulf season. Draft storm-related service pages and ad copy in advance, update the hours on your business profile as soon as plans change, and stop ads while you cannot respond. Restoration and roofing firms should have budgets ready for when it is safe to work.

faqs.q: How do I reach customers in Katy, Sugar Land or The Woodlands?
faqs.a: Treat each as its own market. Build a page for each area, keep a Google profile for each physical location, and set ad targeting around the distance customers will drive.

faqs.q: How much do you charge for digital marketing in Houston?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the scope of work. We discuss your goals in a free consultation and then provide a quote.
